scope: Bernalillo County current and historical capital, roadway, fiber, and stormwater project pages across five existing ABQInfo placements.
findings: Every static PDF and image descendant found on the 20 source pages was already represented in the master inventory.
The current-projects index exposed 41 authored links; every linked child page and its Bridge Boulevard redevelopment-plan PDF was already represented in the retained-source queue or inventory.

Previously reviewed temporary notices and construction schedules retained their existing excluded dispositions; archived design schedules and the Bridge Boulevard plan retained their validated dispositions.
No R2 or site-content change was required.
